extraction.notes: Provider identity mismatch: the supplied rootsandwingsschool.com pages belong to Roots and Wings School in New Boston, New Hampshire, not the Asheville art-and-design provider. No verified 2026 or 2027 supervised summer program information was found for the Asheville provider; cards are therefore empty rather than populated from the unrelated New Hampshire school or older undated materials.
